name: Kichiku no Mongai no Hen
source:
This was released along with Kiminozo Duelist in the âge fanclub.
The story is split in half: Angel by Me and Blood Blade Agla

「Angel by Me」: A black shadow looms over Japan, the powerhouse of moe.
What is the identity of the mysterious girl who appears in Akito's dreams?
Created by Moe Mind and Moe Materials
At the end of the master-servant relationship, there lies the ultimate moe!
Annoying Explosion High Epoch Moe Fantasy!!

「BLOOD✟BLADE / AGLA」: The era that ended the Western calendar. Humans and Sub-Humans ・Furry
The end of the fierce battle with Doon
Is there such a thing? Cursed by the spirit of the Holy Order
What is the strange fate of Nahash...
A hardcore fantasy where the fate of blood guides the sword!!

(Descriptions as displayed on the back cover of the game)
translation:
本作与《Kiminozo Duelist》一同在âge粉丝俱乐部发行。
故事分为两个篇章：《Angel by Me》和《Blood Blade Agla》。

《Angel by Me》：萌系文化重镇日本上空，笼罩着一道黑影。
出现在Akito梦中的神秘少女究竟是谁？
由Moe Mind和Moe Materials创作。
主从关系的尽头，等待着究极萌点！
令人烦恼的爆裂系高纪元萌幻想！！

《BLOOD✟BLADE / AGLA》：西历终结的时代。人类、亚人、兽人。
与Doon的激战迎来终局。
这世上真有此事吗？受到圣秩序之灵的诅咒。
Nahash将迎来怎样离奇的命运……
以血之宿命引导剑刃的硬派奇幻！！

（以上内容摘自游戏盒背说明。）
